profiles.title: Critical article development
profiles.purpose: Develop an evidence-grounded critical article that challenges assumptions, power relations, exclusions, or dominant problem formulations.
profiles.example: Develop a critical article with explicit standpoint and counter-evidence.
expectedOutputs: Problematization architecture, critical article blueprint, full manuscript, simulated reviews, revision, and audit bundle
profiles.warning: The article must not erase contested positions or affected perspectives.
